sources.snippet: Introduction In the past three months since Qwen2's release, numerous developers have built new models on the Qwen2 language models, providing us with valuable feedback. During this period, we have focused on creating smarter and more knowledgeable language models. Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5.

sources.snippet: Apache-2.0-licensed 7B model with surprisingly strong reasoning and multilingual chops. Qwen 2.5 trains on a larger and more carefully filtered corpus than the original Qwen series, and the 7B variant punches well above its weight on coding and math benchmarks. sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-7B incorporates improvements from specialized expert models in coding and mathematics. If you need a base model for a code generation or mathematical reasoning application, fine-tuning this variant gives you better initial performance than generic alternatives.
